criteria.S1: An existing card starts unset; estimate can be set, changed, cleared, and survives reload.
criteria.S2: Only 1, 2, 3, 5, 8 or unset are accepted; invalid input leaves prior value unchanged.
criteria.S3: Detail and board preview show a labeled estimate only when set.
criteria.S4: An unauthorized user or user in another account cannot read or mutate it.
criteria.S5: Existing card workflows and existing records survive the migration.
